blocks.label: Round 1
blocks.instructions:
Round 1: Vessel IdentificationOn each trial, identify the unknown vessel by clicking its signature below.
  • All 5 characteristic frequency bands are visible
  • Study the thumbnail signatures at the bottom — click the matching one

blocks.label: Round 2
blocks.instructions:
Round 2: Frequency UncertaintyDoppler shift and depth changes cause bands to appear at slightly wrong frequencies.
  • All 5 bands are present but each is shifted by roughly +/- 20 Hz
  • Focus on the overall layout, not exact positions

blocks.label: Round 3
blocks.instructions:
Round 3: Noisy ConditionsSea shelf echoes and biologicals add extra bands to the display.
  • All 5 true bands are still present
  • 1-2 extra noise bands are also shown — ignore them

blocks.label: Round 4
blocks.instructions:
Round 4: Acoustic MimicryA nearby vessel adds bands from the other vessel's signature to the display.
  • 5 true bands + 1-2 mimic bands from the opposing vessel
  • Focus on the overall pattern

blocks.label: Round 5
blocks.instructions:
Round 5: Intermittent SignalsCavitation and acoustic shadowing cause bands to randomly disappear.
  • Each true band has a 75% chance of appearing
  • Use all visible evidence — some trials will show only 2-3 bands
